title: refactor(ci): consolidate workflows, upgrade deps and centralize release automation
author: Maya Chen
description: Consolidate duplicated CI workflows across the monorepo, upgrade Node to 20 where safe, pin shared action versions, and centralize release automation into a single reusable workflow. Motivation: multiple repositories and packages had diverging lint/test/release logic causing flaky pipelines and unnecessary maintenance. This PR centralizes CI templates under .github/workflows, reduces duplicate YAML, standardizes caching and node versions, updates a subset of devDependencies (eslint, typescript, actions/cache), and adds a small ci-utils helper to keep shell logic consistent. Includes migration notes and a safety rollout plan to progressively enable the consolidated workflows across packages and to keep per-package overrides possible via repository-level inputs. The description below summarizes changes, commits, files touched, review comments, and CI results.
commits: chore(ci): upgrade node to 20 in shared workflows and actions pins
feat(ci): add reusable release workflow with tag & changelog generation

Liam O'Connor: Cache key changes look good. Minor nits in the eslint config bump — prefer explicit parserOptions for TS project. Marked as resolved.

release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows into reusable templates; upgraded Node to 20 in shared workflows; bumped eslint and typescript dev dependencies; added reusable release workflow and ci-utils helper. Migration notes added to docs/ci-migration.md.
notes_for_backporters: No behavior changes to runtime code. If backporting to older branches, ensure node version and action pins are compatible and update cache keys accordingly.
changelog_entry: ci: consolidate workflows, upgrade node to 20, add reusable release automation
migration_steps: Step 1: Read docs/ci-migration.md for per-repo opt-in instructions
Step 2: Run the workflow_dispatch smoke job on your repo to validate caches and node toolchain
Step 3: If you rely on custom steps, add a per-repo override that imports common-ci.yml and extends jobs
Step 4: Remove legacy CI files after successful opt-in and one successful release pipeline run
